revisit_triplet.visual_note: Ancient temple / same timestamps / nearby camera return
revisit_triplet.caption_detail: After an intervening view of the temple complex, KEEPSAKE returns to a similar left-hand temple and foliage composition. Unbounded returns with the left temple mostly out of frame and a different courtyard composition. The comparison concerns recurrence of generated scene appearance; it does not separate content errors from camera-following errors.

sample_note: Manually selected AncientTempleEnv_5 frames 616, 901 and 1816 (20.53, 30.03 and 60.53 seconds), identical for Unbounded and KEEPSAKE-B32. The nominal 60-second output contains 1825 frames at 30 FPS; labels use actual frame timestamps. Endpoint candidates were drawn from saved pose-return diagnostics, ranked for visual inspection by generated endpoint similarity differences, then manually reviewed. The endpoint poses differ by 0.3483 m and 6.2162 degrees, within the nearby profile's 0.5 m and 10 degree thresholds. Endpoint GT SSIM is 0.1819192 and the group did not pass the original 0.9 GT-similarity gate. This is a nearby-return illustration, not an exact-view reconstruction claim, a measured disappearance interval, or a representative quantitative comparison. Frame 901 was selected visually as an intervening temple-complex view. Full decoded frames are retained unchanged. All six displayed copies omit the rightmost 25 percent, retaining pixels [0, 0, 480, 352] of each 640-by-352 frame, and use the same fixed gamma 0.65 on every RGB channel. The same source-coordinate highlight boxes are remapped into the cropped images. No stretching, local enhancement, inpainting, per-image normalization or metric recomputation. Editable red/green boxes indicate identical image coordinates, not tracked object correspondence.
